testimonials.review: Dr. Rohit is amazing! I was very conscious of my smile, but after 1.5 years of braces, my teeth are perfectly aligned. The EMI option made it very affordable.
I was terrified of getting a root canal, but Dr. Anjali made sure it was completely painless. The clinic is very clean and the staff is very polite.
Brought my 5-year-old son for his first checkup. Dr. Priya was so patient and friendly! Now he isn't scared of the dentist anymore. Highly recommended for kids.
Got two implants done here. The 3D scanning process was very quick. Recovery was smooth and the new teeth feel completely natural. Great facility in Aundh.
